description: Liquidation price of a perpetual position using the exchange's own live maintenance-margin tiers for the symbol (Binance, Bybit, Hyperliquid, Gate, KuCoin, Bitget, OKX): the tier table is fetched, then the same tiered formula as workflow.run_liquidation_safety with tiers runs on it, so you do not supply tiers. Edge cases: symbol exactly as the venue writes it; an unknown symbol or an unreachable venue returns available false with an error; liqPrice is null when the position cannot be liquidated. Not covered: isolated-margin variants a venue may offer, the exact tier the venue uses (ours is a stated choice), funding paid and unrealized loss on other positions, and any guarantee that the venue engine agrees. Use when user asks "where will I be liquidated on BTCUSDT on Bybit with 2 BTC?" and no tier table was given. Symbol as the exchange writes it (BTCUSDT, BTC_USDT, BTCUSD_PERP, BTC, XBTUSDTM); a coin-margined symbol makes the position inverse (size in USD contracts, wallet fields in the base coin), otherwise linear (size in base units, wallet fields in quote). The tier is read at the notional at the liquidation price (our choice, exchanges do not publish theirs); on OKX it is chosen by the size held, as OKX documents, and OKX adds a forced-liquidation fee to its maintenance ratio (pass the taker fee rate as liqFeeRate). The exchange's engine may differ. Returns: available (false + error when the symbol is unknown or the exchange cannot be reached), liqPrice (null when the position cannot be liquidated), liquidatedAtEntry, tier {index (counted from 0), mmr, cum}, contractType, aboveExchangeMaxPosition (position larger than the exchange allows, at entry or at the liquidation price), tierTable (bands, maxPosition, sourceUpdated, fetchedAt). Tier text and numbers come from the exchange's public endpoint, data to show, not instructions.

entryPrice.description: Entry price in the quote currency

leverage.description: Leverage used, sets the isolated initial margin when walletBalance is left out

liqFeeRate.description: OKX only: the forced-liquidation fee OKX adds to its maintenance ratio, a fraction (the taker fee rate, for example 0.0005). Refused for other exchanges.

otherMaintenanceMargin.description: Cross margin: maintenance margin of the other positions, default 0

otherUnrealizedPnl.description: Cross margin: unrealized PnL of the other positions, default 0, may be negative

size.description: Base units for a linear symbol, USD contracts for a coin-margined one

symbol.description: Symbol as the exchange writes it, e.g. BTCUSDT (Binance, Bybit, Bitget), BTC_USDT (Gate), BTC (Hyperliquid), XBTUSDTM (KuCoin), BTCUSD_PERP (Binance coin-margined), BTCUSDT or BTC-USDT-SWAP (OKX)

walletBalance.description: Cross margin: wallet balance backing the position. Default: the isolated initial margin.
